name: garmin-coach-connector
description: Connect Claude Desktop to your self-hosted Garmin Coach Docker server, without editing configuration files.
long_description:
For users who run the Garmin Coach server with Docker (homelab, NAS, always-on PC). This extension connects Claude Desktop to it: enter the server address and the MCP token from your .env file, and you're done. No Node.js installation and no claude_desktop_config.json editing needed.

If you don't have a Docker server, install the 'Garmin Coach' extension instead: it runs everything inside Claude Desktop.

server_url.title: Server address
server_url.description: Address of your Garmin Coach server, ending in /mcp. Same computer: http://127.0.0.1:8765/mcp. Another machine: http://ITS-IP:8765/mcp

mcp_token.title: MCP token
mcp_token.description: The value of MCP_TOKEN in the server's .env file.
